title: Classify GF(p) gap by prime family
description:
Re-run GF(p) post-PPC rows and separate small-prime, medium-prime, and Mersenne behavior.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(7), GF(31), GF(251), GF(65521), and Mersenne31 rows are measured against fflas.
- [hard] The report identifies which prime families need new kernels.
